name: @buka/dsh-plugin-skills
description: In a sidebar page, lists the skills installed globally for every DSH session, flags the ones the npx skills CLI manages, uninstalls each through the right path, keeps a personal list of skill repositories to install later, and exposes them to other plugins through the ctx.bukaSkills service, detecting whether each saved GitHub repository is an npx skills repository or a Claude Code marketplace and flagging the ones that are neither
